items.en: On this Saturday night, fleeing an explosive wildfire.
items.zh: 在这个周六夜晚，人们逃离一场爆炸性野火

items.en: More than 20,000 residents in B.C.'s interior, including our global news team, forced to evacuate
items.zh: 卑诗省内陆两万多居民，包括我们环球新闻的团队，被迫撤离

items.en: from one of the fastest fires crews have ever seen.
items.zh: 这是消防队员见过蔓延最快的火灾之一

items.en: Everything's gone.
items.zh: 什么都没了

items.en: It's all gone.
items.zh: 一切都没了

items.en: New details on the wildfire fight and the forecast.
items.zh: 关于山火扑救和天气预报的最新细节

items.en: President Trump's former lawyer is named the new attorney general.
items.zh: 特朗普前律师被任命为新任司法部长

items.en: The choice is not between perfection and Mr. Blanche.
items.zh: 选择不是在完美和布兰奇先生之间

items.en: The implications for the independence of the U.S. Justice Department.
items.zh: 这对美国司法部独立性的影响

items.en: Plus, fighting for fish.
items.zh: 另外，为鱼类而战

items.en: I really wanted to get involved in helping to save the world.
items.zh: 我真的想参与拯救世界

items.en: Why this B.C. conservationist just had a species of seahorse named in her honour.
items.zh: 为何这位卑诗省环保人士获以她的名字命名一种海马

items.en: Global National.
items.zh: 环球新闻

items.en: Reporting tonight, Jeff Semple.
items.zh: 今晚报道，杰夫·森普尔

items.en: Take a look at this terrifying video
items.zh: 看看这段可怕的视频

items.en: as 20,000 people in B.C.'s Okanagan region fled for their lives last night.
items.zh: 昨晚卑诗省欧肯那根地区两万人逃生时的情景

items.en: A fire, first reported at 5.30 Friday afternoon near the community of Summerland,
items.zh: 周五下午5点30分，夏季兰社区附近首次报告的一场火灾，

items.en: suddenly exploded in size, leaving little time to escape.
items.zh: 突然急剧扩大，几乎没有时间逃生

items.en: Good evening and thank you for joining us.
items.zh: 晚上好，感谢收看我们的节目

items.en: B.C. officials just held a news conference.
items.zh: 卑诗省官员刚刚举行了新闻发布会

items.en: The premier declaring a province-wide state of emergency.
items.zh: 省长宣布全省进入紧急状态

items.en: And B.C.'s wildfire service warned the conditions are explosive
items.zh: 卑诗省山火服务处警告称，情况极具爆炸性

items.en: and unlike anything they've seen before.
items.zh: 且是他们前所未见的

items.en: This is the evacuation zone, the largest so far this year,
items.zh: 这是今年迄今为止最大的疏散区，

items.en: covering the entire municipality of Summerland, B.C.
items.zh: 覆盖卑诗省夏季兰整个市镇

items.en: Surrounding areas are now on high alert.
items.zh: 周边地区现处于高度戒备状态

items.en: Sarah MacDonald begins our coverage tonight.
items.zh: 萨拉·麦克唐纳开始我们今晚的报道

items.en: It exploded with frightening speed and ferocity Friday evening.
items.zh: 周五晚上，火势以惊人的速度和凶猛程度爆发

items.en: And just a few hours later, homes were burning.
items.zh: 仅仅几个小时后，房屋就开始燃烧

items.en: As thousands of British Columbians fled the fast-moving flames,
items.zh: 成千上万的卑诗省民逃离迅速蔓延的火焰，

items.en: closing in on the entire district of Summerland in the Okanagan.
items.zh: 火焰逼近欧肯那根的夏季兰整个地区

items.en: Some 12,000 residents ordered to evacuate overnight.
items.zh: 约一万两千名居民被命令连夜撤离

items.en: Everything's gone.
items.zh: 什么都没了

items.en: It's all gone.
items.zh: 一切都没了

items.en: Dozens flown out by helicopter with no way out by road.
items.zh: 数十人因道路不通由直升机接出

items.en: Hope no one stuck it out as long as we did
items.zh: 希望没人像我们一样坚持那么久

items.en: because they would have been burnt.
items.zh: 因为他们早就被烧到了

items.en: We are preparing to leave this area.
items.zh: 我们准备离开这个区域

items.en: The flames growing in real time on live TV.
items.zh: 火焰在电视直播中实时蔓延

items.en: A global news crew packing up and pivoting fast
items.zh: 环球新闻摄制组迅速收拾设备，快速转移

items.en: as the fire grew too close.
items.zh: 因为火势逼近得太近了

items.en: You guys get out there.
items.zh: 你们先出去

items.en: Your safety is paramount.
items.zh: 你们的安全最重要

items.en: What the fire is going to do.
items.zh: 火势会如何发展

items.en: One regional district official finding his own home was under evacuation order
items.zh: 一名地区官员在向公众通报情况时，

items.en: while keeping the public informed.
items.zh: 发现自己的家也收到了疏散令

items.en: I need to get home to my family and take care of that part of my life.
items.zh: 我需要回家和家人团聚，处理好我生活中的那部分

items.en: The Bald Range fire, classified as a rank 5,
items.zh: 这场被归类为5级的秃山火，

items.en: burning so aggressively, it consumed some 50 square kilometers, or 5,000 hectares, of land.
items.zh: 燃烧得极为猛烈，吞噬了约50平方公里，即5000公顷的土地

items.en: In just three hours after it first ignited, it's since grown much larger.
items.zh: 在首次燃起后的短短三小时内，火势已扩大了很多

items.en: You can feel the heat inside the house starting to rise.
items.zh: 你能感觉到屋内的温度开始升高

items.en: It was pretty obvious it was time to get out.
items.zh: 很明显，是时候离开了

items.en: Many evacuees leaving nearly all of their belongings
items.zh: 许多撤离者几乎将所有财物

items.en: and their livelihoods behind the fire line.
items.zh: 和生计都留在了火线之后

items.en: And in this rural part of the province's interior,
items.zh: 在这个卑诗省内陆的乡村地区，

items.en: filled with farm and ranch land, countless animals are still there.
items.zh: 遍布农场和牧场，无数动物仍在那里

items.en: This here is just ranches, full of ranches and tons of animals, horses, everything.
items.zh: 这里全是牧场，遍地是牧场和成群的动物，马匹，什么都有

items.en: And I just want everybody to get out.
items.zh: 我只希望所有人都能逃出去

items.en: Premier David Eby urging all British Columbians under evacuation order
items.zh: 省长大卫·埃比敦促所有收到疏散令的卑诗省民

items.en: to get out if they haven't already.
items.zh: 如果没有撤离，请立即撤离

items.en: I know many families are facing an unimaginable day today.
items.zh: 我知道今天许多家庭都面临着难以想象的一天

items.en: People have lost their homes and
items.zh: 人们失去了家园，

items.en: many people have been displaced.
items.zh: 许多人流离失所

items.en: Others are waiting for news about loved ones.
items.zh: 还有人在等待亲人的消息

items.en: With the loss of homes, a certainty
items.zh: 随着家园被毁，这是一场确定的灾难，

items.en: and any loss of life still a very real possibility.
items.zh: 而任何生命损失都仍是非常现实的可能性

items.en: Sarah MacDonald, Global News.
items.zh: 环球新闻，莎拉·麦克唐纳报道

items.en: For more on the wildfire situation tonight,
items.zh: 今晚关于野火局势的更多情况，

items.en: let's go to Global's Taya Fast, who joins us from Penticton, B.C.,
items.zh: 让我们连线环球新闻的塔亚 ·法斯特，她在BC省彭蒂克顿，

items.en: where many of the evacuees have gathered.
items.zh: 许多撤离者都聚集在那里

items.en: And Taya, as we just saw in Sarah's report,
items.zh: 塔亚，正如我们刚刚在莎拉的报道中看到的，

items.en: you had your own close call last night.
items.zh: 你昨晚自己也经历了惊险一刻

items.en: Jeff, that's right.
items.zh: 杰夫，没错

items.en: The fire moved so incredibly quickly towards us Friday evening.
items.zh: 周五傍晚，火势极其迅速地朝我们蔓延过来

items.en: What started as a smaller-sized blaze
items.zh: 一开始还是一场规模较小的火灾，

items.en: exploded only within hours to thousands of hectares
items.zh: 仅仅几小时内就爆发式地蔓延到数千公顷，

items.en: and towards where we were standing.
items.zh: 并朝着我们所在的位置扑来

items.en: And the entire hillside was consumed with smoke and large flames.
items.zh: 整个山坡都被浓烟和巨大的火焰吞没

items.en: And the sky was glowing orange
items.zh: 天空泛着橙色的光芒，

items.en: that within minutes we had to make the decision
items.zh: 几分钟内我们就不得不做出决定，

items.en: to leave the area and get off the air.
items.zh: 撤离该地区并停止直播

items.en: We've heard countless stories from people who have lost their homes.
items.zh: 我们听无数人讲述了他们失去家园的经历

items.en: Initially, Electoral Area F, Folder, and West and North Summerland were impacted,
items.zh: 最初， F选区、福尔德以及西萨默兰和北萨默兰都受到了影响，

items.en: but the situation changed quickly.
items.zh: 但情况很快发生了变化

items.en: The entire community of Summerland was ordered to evacuate around 1230 Friday night,
items.zh: 周五晚上12点30分左右，萨默兰整个社区被命令撤离，

items.en: and a local state of emergency was declared.
items.zh: 并宣布进入地方紧急状态

items.en: We tried to leave northbound shortly after,
items.zh: 我们随后不久试图向北撤离，

items.en: but were turned away because the fire had jumped the highway
items.zh: 但被拦了回来，因为大火已经越过了公路，

items.en: and was burning on both sides.
items.zh: 并且在公路两侧燃烧

items.en: Thousands of people made their way south towards Penticton,
items.zh: 成千上万的人向南前往彭蒂克顿，

items.en: and now most, if not all, large parking lots in Penticton
items.zh: 现在彭蒂克顿的大部分（如果不是全部的话）大型停车场

items.en: are full of campers, trailers, and vehicles.
items.zh: 都停满了露营车、拖车和各类车辆

items.en: Those people that fled late in the night.
items.zh: 那些在深夜逃离的人们

items.en: Any evacuees who need support,
items.zh: 任何需要帮助的撤离者，

items.en: the recommendation is that you check in to ESS online
items.zh: 建议你们在线到ESS登记

items.en: or visit one of the reception centers.
items.zh: 或前往其中一个接待中心

items.en: And there's two, one in Penticton at the Penticton Trade and Convention Center.
items.zh: 有两个接待中心，一个在彭蒂克顿的彭蒂克顿贸易与会议中心

items.en: There's also one in West Kelowna at the West Bank Lions Community Hall.
items.zh: 还有一个在西基洛纳的西岸狮子会社区大厅

items.en: Now, the support for these evacuees has been overwhelming.
items.zh: 现在，对这些撤离者的支持非常踊跃

items.en: We've seen dozens, if not more, volunteers going car to car in the parking lots.
items.zh: 我们看到几十名（甚至更多）志愿者在停车场里挨车询问

items.en: The pile of donations up front of the Trade and Convention Center
items.zh: 贸易与会议中心前面的捐赠物资

items.en: is just growing by the minute,
items.zh: 每分钟都在增加，

items.en: and there's lots of food here and other necessities for evacuees to take.
items.zh: 这里有很多食物和其他必需品供撤离者取用

items.en: Jeff?
items.zh: 杰夫？

items.en: All right.
items.zh: 好的

items.en: Teofast in Penticton, B.C., take care.
items.zh: 以上是BC省彭蒂克顿的塔亚·法斯特的报道，请注意安全

items.en: The fires around Summerland and across B.C.
items.zh: 萨默兰及BC省各地的火灾

items.en: are being fueled by hot and dry conditions.
items.zh: 正受到炎热干燥天气的助长

items.en: Let's go now to Global News meteorologist Yvonne Schell.
items.zh: 现在让我们连线环球新闻气象学家伊冯娜·谢尔

items.en: So, Yvonne, can we expect any relief?
items.zh: 那么，伊冯娜，我们能期待情况有所缓解吗？

items.en: Thanks so much, Jeff.
items.zh: 非常感谢，杰夫

items.en: Unfortunately, there's no reprieve in the forecast.
items.zh: 不幸的是，天气预报中没有任何缓解的迹象

items.en: We continue with hot and dry conditions.
items.zh: 炎热干燥的天气状况将持续

items.en: And the big concern, especially as we get in towards the peak temperatures,
items.zh: 而最大的担忧是，尤其是在临近最高气温的时候，

items.en: afternoon and early evening is when we see the lowest relative humidity,
items.zh: 下午和傍晚时分，我们会看到最低的相对湿度，

items.en: and that's also fueling the fires.
items.zh: 这也在助长火势

items.en: Starting off with a few photos that have been captured.
items.zh: 先来看几张拍摄到的照片

items.en: This one from Vancouver City Councilor Mike Klassen, taken in Summerland.
items.zh: 这张是温哥华市议员迈克·克拉森在萨默兰拍摄的

items.en: Another shot from Summerland showing the explosive fires.
items.zh: 另一张来自萨默兰的照片显示了爆炸性的火势

items.en: This one taken by Ted.
items.zh: 这张是泰德拍摄的

items.en: And a shot from Peachland showing the fires.
items.zh: 这是从桃李兰传来的山火画面

items.en: And this one was captured by Kim.
items.zh: 这张由金拍摄

items.en: Here's a shot of what it looks like from NASA.
items.zh: 这是美国宇航局视角下的画面

items.en: Above, we can see that thick smoke blanketing much of the southern interior.
items.zh: 上方可以看到浓烟笼罩着南部内陆大部分地区

items.en: It'll be similar as we get in towards tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天情况也会类似

items.en: We've got poor air quality and reduced visibility.
items.zh: 空气质量差，能见度降低

items.en: Also, we're looking at windy conditions.
items.zh: 此外，还伴有大风天气

items.en: Picking up 20 and up to 30 kilometers per hour from most areas near Summerland.
items.zh: 萨默兰附近大部分地区风速达20到30公里每小时

items.en: Much of the southern interior will see the winds pick up once again tomorrow.
items.zh: 明天南部内陆大部分地区将再次刮起大风

items.en: It'll be quite similar.
items.zh: 情况会非常相似

items.en: So, no reprieve in the forecast.
items.zh: 所以，预报中没有缓解的迹象

items.en: We're also seeing those temperatures soaring Sunday, Monday, and into early next week.
items.zh: 我们也看到周日、周一及下周初气温将飙升

items.en: Upper 20s closer to 30 degrees.
items.zh: 接近30度，最高气温在20多度以上

items.en: Wednesday, Thursday will be into the low 20s.
items.zh: 周三、周四气温将降至20度出头

items.en: There's no break or significant moisture.
items.zh: 不会有间歇或明显降水

items.en: And we're also seeing the air quality warning that still remains in effect.
items.zh: 而且空气质量警告仍然生效

items.en: So, those with respiratory issues
items.zh: 所以，有呼吸系统疾病的人

items.en: will want to try and limit the amount of time spent outdoors.
items.zh: 要尽量减少户外活动时间

items.en: Latest fire danger rating for the southern interior sitting at high.
items.zh: 南部内陆最新火灾危险等级为高

items.en: Many spots across the interior sitting at extreme.
items.zh: 内陆许多地区已达到极高

items.en: Jeff, back to you.
items.zh: 杰夫，交回给你

items.en: Global News meteorologist Yvonne Schell.
items.zh: 环球新闻气象学家伊冯娜·谢尔

items.en: Thanks, Yvonne.
items.zh: 谢谢，伊冯娜

items.en: And turning to other news now.
items.zh: 现在转向其他新闻

items.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's former defense lawyer
items.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的前辩护律师

items.en: has just been confirmed as attorney general
items.zh: 刚刚被确认为司法部长

items.en: after a close vote in the Senate overnight.
items.zh: 此前参议院连夜进行了投票，结果非常接近

items.en: Todd Blanche's appointment puts a close Trump ally
items.zh: 托德·布兰奇的任命让特朗普的亲信

items.en: at the helm of the Justice Department.
items.zh: 执掌了司法部

items.en: As Candace Cole reports,
items.zh: 据坎迪斯·科尔报道，

items.en: Democrats and some Republicans are voicing concerns.
items.zh: 民主党人和一些共和党人表达了担忧

items.en: On this vote, the yeas are 50.
items.zh: 本次投票，赞成票为50票

items.en: The nays are 49.
items.zh: 反对票为49票

items.en: The nomination is confirmed.
items.zh: 提名已确认

items.en: Early Saturday morning, in an overnight vote,
items.zh: 周六凌晨，在一次连夜投票中，

items.en: the U.S. Senate confirmed Todd Blanche's nomination
items.zh: 美国参议院确认了托德·布兰奇的提名，

items.en: for attorney general to lead the Department of Justice.
items.zh: 由其出任司法部长领导司法部

items.en: Blanche, U.S. President Donald Trump's former personal attorney,
items.zh: 布兰奇，曾是美国总统特朗普的私人律师，

items.en: had been serving as acting attorney general
items.zh: 自帕姆·邦迪四月份

items.en: since Pam Bondi's ouster in April
items.zh: 因处理爱泼斯坦文件不当被罢免后，

items.en: over her handling of the Epstein files.
items.zh: 一直担任代理司法部长

items.en: For weeks, Blanche's confirmation was in limbo
items.zh: 数周以来，布兰奇的确认一直悬而未决，

items.en: as multiple Republican senators,
items.zh: 因为多名共和党参议员，

items.en: enough to tank the vote,
items.zh: 人数足以否决投票，

items.en: voiced concern over Trump's anti-weaponization fund,
items.zh: 对特朗普的反武器化基金表示担忧，

items.en: set up by the DOJ,
items.zh: 该基金由司法部设立，

items.en: largely seen by both parties
items.zh: 两党普遍认为

items.en: as a slush fund for January 6 rioters.
items.zh: 这是给1月6日骚乱者的贿赂基金

items.en: Blanche had testified early on
items.zh: 布兰奇早些时候曾作证

items.en: that the DOJ would not move forward
items.zh: 司法部不会继续

items.en: with implementing the fund.
items.zh: 实施该基金

items.en: However, it took Blanche formally terminating the fund Sunday
items.zh: 然而，直到布兰奇周日正式终止该基金，

items.en: to get some skeptical Republicans on board.
items.zh: 才争取到一些持怀疑态度的共和党人支持

items.en: I've never liked this 1776 fund.
items.zh: 我从来都不喜欢这个1776基金

items.en: It made no sense to me,
items.zh: 这对我来说毫无意义，

items.en: and I thought it was an insult to the police officers
items.zh: 我认为这是对1月6日

items.en: and the people that defended us on January the 6th.
items.zh: 保护我们的警察和人民的侮辱

items.en: It's done.
items.zh: 结束了

items.en: It's been rescinded, and I am satisfied.
items.zh: 它已被撤销，我很满意

items.en: Due to Senator Mitch McConnell still being out
items.zh: 由于参议员米奇·麦康奈尔仍在休养

items.en: on medical leave,
items.zh: 正在休病假，

items.en: Blanche could only afford to lose two Republican votes,
items.zh: 布兰奇只能承受失去两票共和党人的支持，

items.en: which ended up being Senators Susan Collins
items.zh: 结果反对的是参议员苏珊·柯林斯

items.en: and Lisa Murkowski.
items.zh: 和丽莎·穆尔科斯基

items.en: At the 11th hour,
items.zh: 在最后一刻，

items.en: Senator Bill Cassidy,
items.zh: 参议员比尔·卡西迪，

items.zh: 作为UBC海马项目的联合创始人，她领导着一支全球团队进行研究、

items.en: conservation and policy,
items.zh: 保护和政策制定，

items.en: which includes ensuring seahorses aren't over-harvested for traditional medicine, aquarium displays or the souvenir trade.
items.zh: 包括确保海马不会因传统医药、水族观赏或纪念品贸易而被过度捕捞

items.en: Fishing is necessary.
items.zh: 捕鱼是必要的

items.en: Fishing is vital.
items.zh: 捕鱼至关重要

items.en: But it's got to be done in sustainable, sensible ways.
items.zh: 但必须以可持续、合理的方式进行

items.en: And this means we work at a lot of different political levels from local communities right out to United Nations conventions.
items.zh: 这意味着我们得在多个不同政治层面工作，从当地社区一直到联合国公约

items.en: Now her life's work is being recognised in a way that runs deep.
items.zh: 现在，她一生的工作以一种深刻的方式得到了认可

items.en: This is my beautiful seahorse.
items.zh: 这是我美丽的海马

items.en: A newly identified species has been named Hippocampus Amanda Vincente in her honour.
items.zh: 一个新发现的物种被命名为“文森特海马”，以向她致敬

items.en: I'm thrilled.
items.zh: 我激动不已

items.en: It's pretty wonderful to wake up and open your email and discover just two days ago
items.zh: 醒来打开邮件，就在两天前发现

items.en: that there is a creature on the other side of the world that is beautiful and wonderful and special and has your name on it.
items.zh: 世界的另一边有一种美丽、奇妙又特别的生物，并且以你的名字命名，这真是太美好了

items.en: The seahorse measures roughly 16 centimetres.
items.zh: 这种海马长约16厘米

items.en: It has a short snout,
items.zh: 它有一个短吻，

items.en: a small crown on top of its head and spines running along its body.
items.zh: 头顶有一个小冠，身体上有一排排的棘刺

items.en: Researchers believe it's primarily located in the Indian Ocean.
items.zh: 研究人员认为它主要生活在印度洋

items.en: And that's really all we know at this stage because it has not been investigated in the wild.
items.zh: 目前我们了解的就这么多，因为它还没有在野外被研究过

items.en: Cue the next mission.
items.zh: 这预示着下一个任务

items.en: Which is to get in the field with my glorious seahorse and actually learn about its ecology and its vulnerabilities
items.zh: 那就是去野外，与我光荣的海马一起，真正了解它的生态和脆弱性，

items.en: and conservation possibilities and try to make sure that all is well.
items.zh: 以及保护的可能性，并努力确保一切安好

items.en: Seahorses are under tremendous pressure.
items.zh: 海马承受着巨大的压力

items.en: Roughly a third of them are known to be threatened.
items.zh: 已知大约有三分之一的海马物种面临威胁

items.en: But with every discovery brings more understanding and a chance to turn the tides.
items.zh: 但每一次发现都带来更多理解，以及扭转局势的机会

items.en: We've got new approaches, new tools, new colleagues involved.
items.zh: 我们有新的方法、新的工具、新的同事加入

items.en: So it's very exciting to see that we're changing the trajectory by the passion and the hard work of a lot of people.
items.zh: 所以，看到我们正通过众多人的热情和努力改变发展轨迹，这非常令人兴奋

items.en: Kelly Stanton, Global News.
items.zh: 凯莉·斯坦顿，环球新闻

items.en: And that is Global National for this Saturday night.
items.zh: 以上就是本周六晚的《环球新闻》

items.en: I'm Jeff Sumpel.
items.zh: 我是杰夫·萨姆佩尔

items.en: And tonight's Your Canada is this country's largest street festival.
items.zh: 今晚的《你的加拿大》介绍的是这个国家最大的街头节庆

items.en: The Taste of the Danforth in Toronto's Greektown neighbourhood is making a comeback this weekend after a two-year hiatus.
items.zh: 多伦多希腊城社区的丹佛斯美食节在中断两年后，于本周末回归

items.en: Around one and a half million people are expected to sample the three-day celebration of Greek heritage.
items.zh: 预计将有约150万人参与这个为期三天的希腊文化遗产庆祝活动

items.en: Looking good.
items.zh: 看起来不错

items.en: Thanks for watching.
items.zh: 感谢收看

items.en: Hope to see you back here again tomorrow.
items.zh: 希望明天能再次见到你

items.en: Have a great night.
items.zh: 祝你度过一个美好的夜晚
